# The first-run tour: in Hebrew the "<" and ">" look buttons point outwards (previous on the left, next on the right);
# in Spanish the songs page shows every line above the Demo song button. A 1280x720 window gives GUI scale 3 at most
# (426x240); the helper's button spots: Show me around 290,197, Next 320,197.
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=<branch> -f script=.github/checks/tour.txt

cmd time set noon
look 0 -20
sleep 6
lang he_il
sleep 15
guiscale 3
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.IntroScreen
sleep 3
shot tour-he-0
click 290 197
sleep 2
shot tour-he-1
close
